Explain in your own words what 'Regional Economic Groupings' refers to.
questions.a: Alliances formed by nations to integrate their economies, coordinate trade policies, and enhance global competitiveness.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Regional Economic Groupings'.
questions.a: Nations form regional groups to expand their economic space and learn from neighbours' developmental strategies.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Regional Economic Groupings' taught, and from which source text?

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Comparative Development Timelines' refers to.
questions.a: The historical timeline of planning and economic strategies initiated by India, China, and Pakistan since their inception.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Comparative Development Timelines'.
questions.a: India and Pakistan started in 1947, China in 1949; all adopted planned development models.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Comparative Development Timelines' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.2 DEVELOPMENTAL PATH—A SNAPSHOT VIEW (source: keec108.txt lines 75-115)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Great Leap Forward (GLF) Campaign' refers to.
questions.a: A massive industrialisation campaign launched in China in 1958 to encourage backyard industries and collective farming through communes.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Great Leap Forward (GLF) Campaign'.
questions.a: Rapid industrialisation and agricultural collectivisation through the commune system.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Great Leap Forward (GLF) Campaign' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.2 DEVELOPMENTAL PATH—A SNAPSHOT VIEW (source: keec108.txt lines 120-145)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution' refers to.
questions.a: An ideological and social campaign introduced by Mao Zedong in 1965 to send students and professionals to work and learn in rural areas.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution'.
questions.a: Sending urban youth and professionals to the countryside to bridge the gap between manual and intellectual work.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Great Proletarian Cultural Revolution' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.2 DEVELOPMENTAL PATH—A SNAPSHOT VIEW (source: keec108.txt lines 145-155)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Dual Pricing Policy' refers to.
questions.a: A reform-era pricing mechanism where inputs and outputs are bought and sold at government-fixed prices for a set quota, and at market prices for any excess.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Dual Pricing Policy'.
questions.a: Transitioning from a command economy to a market economy by using both state-determined and market-determined prices.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Dual Pricing Policy' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.2 DEVELOPMENTAL PATH—A SNAPSHOT VIEW (source: keec108.txt lines 175-195)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Demographic Indicators' refers to.
questions.a: Statistical metrics including population size, growth rate, density, sex ratio, fertility rate, and urbanisation used to compare population characteristics.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Demographic Indicators'.
questions.a: China has the lowest density and growth rate (due to the one-child norm), while Pakistan has the highest growth and fertility rates.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Demographic Indicators' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.3 DEMOGRAPHIC INDICATORS (source: keec108.txt lines 210-255)

concepts.title: Sectoral Share of GVA and Employment

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Sectoral Share of GVA and Employment' refers to.
questions.a: The analysis of how agriculture, industry, and services contribute to a nation's total output (GVA) and how they employ the workforce.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Sectoral Share of GVA and Employment'.
questions.a: China followed the classical shift (agriculture to industry to services), while India and Pakistan shifted directly from agriculture to services.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Sectoral Share of GVA and Employment' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.4 GROSS DOMESTIC PRODUCT AND SECTORS (source: keec108.txt lines 290-345)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Human Development Indicators' refers to.
questions.a: Socio-economic metrics such as life expectancy, schooling years, GNI per capita, infant and maternal mortality, and sanitation access used to assess well-being.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Human Development Indicators'.
questions.a: China ranks significantly higher (78th) in HDI compared to India (130th) and Pakistan (168th).

questions.q: Under which section is 'Human Development Indicators' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.5 INDICATORS OF HUMAN DEVELOPMENT (source: keec108.txt lines 350-400)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Liberty Indicators' refers to.
questions.a: Measures that evaluate the degree of civil liberties, democratic participation, rule of law, and independence of the judiciary in a society.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Liberty Indicators'.
questions.a: HDI is incomplete without considering the extent of political freedom and constitutional protection of rights.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Liberty Indicators' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: 8.5 INDICATORS OF HUMAN DEVELOPMENT (source: keec108.txt lines 400-420)
